t: Ahead of you is St John's, Smith Square, a former church that now serves as a concert hall in the middle of Smith Square in Westminster. Its current operator, Sinfonia Smith Square, changed its name to Smith Square Hall in 2024. The building was designed by Thomas Archer, an English Baroque architect. His work is notable because he's the only English Baroque architect to show evidence of studying Italian and continental buildings. George Burrington, a former governor of North Carolina, is buried here.
